definitions.explanation: Opening remarks placed at the front of a book or paper, explaining its aim and background. A formal term found mainly in academic and scholarly works.

examples.japanese: {緒言|しょげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{緒言|しょげん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べている→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: The author states the purpose of the research in the preface.

examples.japanese: {専門書|せんもんしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{緒言|しょげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まとめられている→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The preface of a specialist book often summarizes the background of the field.

notes:
A formal, written-language word used chiefly in academic books and papers. Also read ちょげん. In everyday writing まえがき or はじめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ are far more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{序文|じょぶん}→序文：06205_jobun⟧: preface — a near-synonym; {緒言|しょげん} sounds more academic.
- まえがき: foreword — the plain, everyday equivalent.
- ⟦あとがき→あとがき：21507_atogaki⟧: afterword — the closing counterpart placed at the end.
